miniProject.title: Reliable gateway with quotas, shedding and recovery drills
miniProject.brief: Build the `gateway/` around a fitting engine with auth, quotas, routing, shedding, telemetry, SLOs, canary and runbooks. Fault drills prove bounded detection and clean recovery before fleet scale.
steps: Serve typed chat completions with SSE down to `[DONE]`, per-request queue backpressure and a small fixed-schema structured output, checked against the ch03 stream tests and a vLLM stream. Keep raw bytes and reassembly.

Add API-key auth, a token-bucket limiter with `Retry-After`, deadline propagation with upstream close, idempotent retries by `x-request-id`, and allow-listed media fetch, passing the Project 103 suite. Keep limiter and dedupe tests.

Implement token-aware and prefix-hash routing with adapter affinity and `FailOpen` fallback, plus work-based admission with priority shedding and a budgeted breaker, checked against the day24 routing and burst drills. Keep replay counts and tail evidence.

Split cold start into provision, load and warmup with liveness, readiness and inference-health probes and drain, then run a canary with rollback on error and tail gates, sized by compatibility, replica and reserve math from the day26 drills. Keep timings and gate evaluations.

Enforce per-tenant quotas with salted prefix isolation and a cross-key attack drill, emit per-request logs, metrics and traces joined by `request_id`, and compute tiered SLOs with budget burn and goodput from raw records using the ch16 and ch17 bundles. Keep isolation and dashboard evidence.

Kill a fitting engine under load to show bounded detection, reroute and rejoin, climb the degradation ladder through dependency and cache drills, roll back a bad version on canary gates, and write runbooks with first-cause timelines proven by recovery load tests. Keep all drill evidence.
deliverables: `gateway/` with auth, quotas, routing, shedding, probes, canary and SLO dashboards plus tests.
Isolation, telemetry and fault evidence: salted-cache tests, attack drill, traces and budget burn.
Runbooks with first-cause timelines and recovery load-test evidence showing clean return to SLO.

checks.name: llm-model-inference ch03 streaming tests
checks.note: Assert stream framing and concurrent isolation; then assert `[DONE]` on vLLM.

checks.name: Project 103 API and middleware tests
checks.note: Pass all seven stubbed tests for auth, limits and streaming.

checks.name: 100 Days day24 routing and burst
checks.note: Run routing, hash-ring and burst drills; port the ring to gateway.

checks.name: 100 Days day26 canary and recovery
checks.note: Rerun canary scenarios and drain; write timelines from stored evidence.

checks.name: AI Systems ch16 monitoring bundle
checks.note: Deploy monitors under load and show one alert with overhead.

checks.name: AI Systems ch17 QoS gates
checks.note: Port tiered gates and show premium passing under pressure.

rubric.pass: Stream suites pass with `[DONE]` reassembly, limiter and dedupe tests pass, and routing with shedding shows tiered burst protection.
rubric.strong: A slow-reader case grows queues without pausing generation, and breaker trips are measured.

rubric.pass: Quota and salted-cache tests show no cross-tenant hit, telemetry joins by `request_id`, and SLOs with goodput come from raw records.
rubric.strong: The key attack drill names first cause, and tier burn is tracked through the burst.

rubric.pass: Worker, dependency, cache and bad-version drills store detection and recovery evidence, and runbooks with timelines execute cleanly.
rubric.strong: Recovery load tests return queues, KV and tails inside SLO with every request accounted.

miniProject.feedsInto: `gateway/` with SLOs, isolation evidence and runbooks feeds capacity planning and the capstone operations package.
